faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) position is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class Post Graduate Degree in a relevant non-medical/life science or engineering/IT/computer science equivalent field. Integrated PG degrees are also accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST and OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How will the candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) post at AIIMS Delhi will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 56,000/- per month, along with House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates apply for this job?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email. They should prepare their application with all necessary documents and send it to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs with their application.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual position. The recruitment is for a Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) post on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply link?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF and the link to apply via email will be available in the "Important Links" section of this article. Please check there for direct access.
